title: A man named Bernie proposes ESP as a savant skill in non-speaking autistic people

tellings.quote: who first kind of came up with this idea that that maybe tele not telepathy but ESP gifts are should be a savant skill

plain: A man named only as Bernie was the first to suggest that ESP gifts, meaning abilities like sensing things without the ordinary senses, should count as a savant skill, a rare exceptional talent, in autistic people who do not speak. The documentary filmmaker Ky Dickens tells this as part of her research for a series on telepathy in such children, also naming the researcher Diane Powell. If true, it would place mind-reading alongside other known savant abilities.
